name: New Wave: De Reünie
overview: Ten years after the groundbreaking New Wave project, Lil Kleine, Frenna, Ronnie Flex, Jonna Fraser, Lijpe and others come together again. The rappers and producers look back on their unexpected breakthrough, the sacrifices they made for fame and the mutual connection. As they work towards five sold-out shows in the Ziggo Dome, it becomes clear what is left of the magic that set everything in motion.
